title: A2-06 · The imperative and the prohibition

blocks.text: A2-06 · The imperative and the prohibition
Lesson overview

The imperative ( ⁧الأَمْر⁩ ) is used to give instructions, advice and orders; the ban to say what not to do. These are the forms of signs, instructions at the airport, forms and, for a policeman, many service phrases (sit down) , ... complete this form , ... don't touch it). They are all built on the juxtaposition of A2-05: if you can say ⁧لَمْ تَكْتُبْ⁩ , you can already say "write!" and "don't write!" A week.

rows: A2 · Module A2.1 The verbal system
6–7 hours · one week (week 59 of the calendar)

blocks.text: Materials This unit, Anki deck A2 (tag A2-06), script for speech synthesis, session with tutor
Targets. At the end of the lesson you know:
1. form the imperative of a regular verb in all people (m., f., dual, plural m. e f.);
2. Choose the supporting vowel ( ⁧اُ⁩ or ⁧اِ⁩ ) and recognize the imperative of form IV with ⁧أَ⁩ ;
3. to form the imperative of the most frequent weak verbs and irregular verbs ( ⁧قُلْ⁩ , ⁧ضَعْ⁩ , ⁧خُذْ⁩ , ⁧كُلْ⁩ , ⁧تَعَالَ⁩ …);
4. to make a ban with ⁧لَا⁩ + Judging;
5. Make a request more kind and recognize the impersonal forms of cartels ( ⁧مَمْنُوع⁩ , ⁧الرَّجَاءُ⁩ , ⁧يُرْجَى⁩ );
6. give and request simple instructions in voice and in writing.

blocks.text: What to notice. Hudā use the "Tu" ( ⁧اِجْلِسْ⁩ , ⁧خُذْ⁩ , ⁧وَقِّعْ⁩ ): in Arabic, the imperative does not have a kindness such as the Italian "Lei" (Italian); the courtesy passes by the tone, ⁧تَفَضَّلْ⁩ and for formulas (section 5). In the Italian translation we use the "lei" . ⁧اِمْلَأْهَا⁩ , ⁧اُتْرُكْهُ⁩ : the object pronoun attaches itself to the imperative. ⁧وَاكْتُبِ اسْمَكَ⁩ : after ⁧وَ⁩ the support wing is not pronounced (wa-ktubi), and the sukūn Takes one i in front of the alif waṣla of ⁧اِسْم. لَا تَقْلَقْ⁩ - do not worry, and ⁧لَا تَنْسَ⁩ "Do not forget" are prohibitions: ⁧لَا⁩ + Judging. ⁧نُسْخَة⁩ (a) a copy of the certificate; ⁧فِي الأَسْفَلِ⁩ They're in the vocabulary.
2. The imperative of regular verbs
The imperative exists only for the second person (you, you). It is formed by the juxtaposed:
1. Take the judge of the second person: ⁧تَكْتُبْ⁩ , ⁧تَكْتُبِي⁩ , ⁧تَكْتُبَا⁩ , ⁧تَكْتُبُوا⁩ , ⁧تَكْتُبْنَ⁩ ;
2. remove the prefix ⁧تَـ⁩ : ⁧كْتُبْ⁩ …;
3. if the word begins with two consonants (k-t-), add an aliif with vowel support: ⁧اُ⁩ if vowel of the root is u , ⁧اِ⁩ if it is a or i .
vol (f.) ⁧اُكْتُبْنَ⁩ uktubna ⁧اِذْهَبْنَ⁩ iḏhabna ⁧اِجْلِسْنَ⁩ iǧlisna

The alif of the imperative is an alif waṣla : after a word that ends in vowel, or after ⁧وَ⁩ / ⁧فَ⁩ , the following shall not be pronounced: ⁧وَاكْتُبْ⁩ wa-ktub, ⁧ثُمَّ اذْهَبْ⁩ ṯumma ḏhab. The derived forms.

4. The ban: ⁧لَا⁩ + Judging
To say "don't do it": you don't use the imperative: you use ⁧لَا⁩ + second person's rating, with the prefix.
⁧لَا تَتَأَخَّرْتَأَخَّرْ⁩ Don't be late.

Attention to comparison with A2-03: ⁧لَا⁩ + indicative is the negation of the present ( ⁧لَا تَكْتُبُ⁩ • do not write • ⁧لَا⁩ + the prohibition is justified ( ⁧لَا تَكْتُبْ⁩ Do not write! In regular verbs the difference is only in the final vowel; In the weak and in the people with suffix you can see well: ⁧لَا تَنْسَى⁩ Do not forget to... ⁧لَا تَنْسَ⁩ Don't forget! ⁧لَا⁩
⁧تَكْتُبُونَ⁩ / ⁧لَا تَكْتُبُوا⁩ .
5. Courtesy, cartels, instructions
Make a request polite. The nude imperative can sound abrupt. It softens with:

rows: ⁧لَوْ سَمَحْتَ⁩ / ⁧سَمَحْتِ⁩ If you allow me, please.

blocks.text: ⁧تَفَضَّلْ⁩ + imperative .... ⁧تَفَضَّلْ، اُدْخُلْ.⁩

⁧لَوْ سَمَحْتَ⁩ is mainly used to attract attention or for a small request to a stranger (at the bar, on the street); ⁧مِنْ فَضْلِكَ⁩ It's fine everywhere. The signs. In public notices Arabic avoids imperative and uses impersonal forms with an action name (maṣdar):

On the signs words are usually without vowels and often without article or with only structure: ⁧ممنوع التدخين⁩ , ⁧الدخول⁩ , ⁧المخرج. عَدَم⁩ "non" is the negation of the names of action: ⁧عَدَمُ التَّدْخِينِ⁩ Do not smoke.
6. Pronunciation

The support wing falls. uktub alone, but wa-ktub, ṯumma ktub; iǧlis, but fa-ǧlis. Do not pronounce the alif waṣla Inside the sentence. The ⁧أَ⁩ of form IV remains. Arsil, wa-arsil (not wa-rsil); aġliq, wa-aġliq. Very short impressions. Here, kun, nam, ḍaʿ, qif, ḫuḏ, kul: a single syllable with short vowel. Say it with a firm tone, but accompany them with ⁧مِنْ فَضْلِكَ⁩ . ⁧تَعَالَ⁩ . taʿāla, with the accent on ā long: ta-ʿā-la. Women taʿālay, plural taʿālaw.

13. Oral production

1. To the door. Playing with the tutor: you are the agent at the door and the tutor an Arabic tourist who has I lost my wallet. Give kind instructions (sit down, fill out, write, sign, wait) and at least two prohibitions.
2. Ask for instructions. Now you are the tourist: ask the tutor how to get to the station and what to do for buy a ticket. Repeat the instructions received to verify that you understand.
3. The right sign. The tutor describes a situation in English (a waiting room of a hospital) you propose two signs in Arabic and read them out loud.

Twenty points; Exceeding at least 16. A · Emissary (8 points). Write: 1. write (f.) · 2. income (m.) · 3. wait (m.) · 4. send (m.) · 5. Say (m.) · 6. take (f.) · 7. come (pl.) · 8. Signature (m.) Translate: 13. ⁧ممنوع التصوير⁩ · 14. ⁧الرجاء إغلاق الباب⁩ · 15. ⁧يرجى الانتظار هنا⁩ · 16. Write in Arabic: "No entry" D · Instructions (4 points). 17–20. Write four kind instructions for a tourist who must fill out a form at the counter (sit down, fill in, sign up, wait), with at least one courtesy formula.
17. To switch to the module test

With A2-06 closes the form A2.1. Switch to module test A2.1 (week 60) if you have at least 16/20 in this verification and at least 16/20 in the verifications A2-01 → A2-05. Before the test review the tables of weak verbs in the four ways (indicative, conjunctive, juxtative, imperative): they are the heart of the module. If a previous check is below threshold, use the buffer week to do it again.
